name: Bring the Light
label: Quest
description: Bring the Light: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Scourge is a persistent threat to the Alliance, a fact I am sure you know quite well. Recently, we have come across some very peculiar findings, friend.

In the Barrens lies a horrid tangle of briars called Razorfen Downs. While once it was the home of simple quilboar, now it has become apparent that a pact was made with the Scourge, creating creatures far worse... They are now ruled by the lich, Amnennar the Coldbringer.
Align yourself with the Light, friend; put an end to this evil union.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Amnennar must be eradicated. Go, swiftly.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. The Scourge will now think twice before attempting to bolster its ranks again.
May you be blessed by the Light.
